# KMT Global

> KMT Global is a Korean contract supplier of iron castings and machined parts for overseas buyers. One contract covers engineering review, production setup across a Korean manufacturing network, quality control and inspection, and export. KMT Global is an affiliate of KOREA METAL TEC CO., LTD. (케이엠텍㈜), a gray and ductile iron foundry in Goryeong, Korea; each production site is a separate legal entity.

## What KMT Global does
- Contract party for overseas buyers: one contract, one point of contact (Korean, English, Japanese), accountable for quality, delivery and export
- Engineering review, staffed by engineers of affiliate KOREA METAL TEC who also serve KMT Global: drawing and castability review (DFM); casting method, pattern and target-chemistry design for the affiliate's Goryeong plant, and review of partner foundries' methods and chemistry; material and quality engineering; machining support (review of the machining partner's process plan and measurement results, tolerance review)
- Production setup: assigns each part to the right production route and manages schedule and delivery
- Quality: inspection standards; shipment inspection by the producing site (KOREA METAL TEC's quality team for the Goryeong plant), with KMT Global checking the records and lots; witness or third-party inspection arranged per order; traceable documents (where an EN 10204 3.1 certificate is required, it is issued by the manufacturer, with availability confirmed at quotation, and passed on by KMT Global; KMT Global's own shipment inspection confirmation record is not a 3.1 certificate)
- Export: packing, shipping documents, Incoterms agreed per order
- Customer drawings: apart from the engineering review (by affiliate KOREA METAL TEC engineers who also serve KMT Global), they are shared only with production sites the customer approves in writing. An NDA is signed where required and can come before any drawing is sent. The affiliate's Goryeong plant is named from the start; partner foundries and machining partners for an order (name and location) are disclosed after an NDA

## Production network
- Furan no-bake casting (small to large, single pieces and low-to-mid volumes) at affiliate KOREA METAL TEC, Goryeong plant: gray iron up to 10 t, ductile iron up to 5 t per piece, about 1,000 t/month; ISO 9001:2015 held by KOREA METAL TEC CO., LTD. (certificate Q240233, certification body GMSCS — GMS Certification Services, KAB-accredited KAB-QC-83; scope "Manufacture of Casting Product for Machine Tool, Ship, Industrial Machinery"; valid 2026-07-13 to 2029-07-17). KMT Global itself holds no certification.
- Automatic molding lines (high-volume small parts: automotive and driveline, agricultural, construction equipment, rail track, engine parts) at partner foundries, including an IATF 16949-certified foundry (certificate held by that foundry). The production site for an order (name and location) is disclosed after an NDA, within a scope agreed with that site in advance.
- Machining by external machining partners; KMT Global reviews their process plans and measurement results
- Materials: gray iron (KS GC / JIS FC) and ductile iron (KS GCD / JIS FCD); equivalents to ASTM / EN are approximate and confirmed per drawing

## Typical parts
Machine-tool beds, columns, saddles and tables; pump casings; gear cases; bases and counterweights; differential and transfer cases; axle cases; wheel hubs; rail base and turnout plates; rocker-arm supports.

## How to work with us
RFQ (an NDA can be signed before drawings are sent) → NDA (if needed) → engineering review and route selection (written approval before drawings go to a production site) → quotation and contract → patterns and tooling → first article (PPAP where required; single pieces and small orders, if agreed at quotation: pre-shipment inspection results and buyer approval instead, witness arranged per order) → production → shipment inspection → export → after-sales support. Before the quotation the buyer receives a drawing review (DFM) report; the casting method and inspection plan follow after the order. Lead times and prices are quoted per part after drawing review.
